name: Juniper
bio:
Fresh from the vibrant Birmingham music scene, Juniper have teamed up with award-winning percussionist and producer Cormac Byrne (The Haar, Seth Lakeman Band) to develop and release their second album ‘Halfway Home’.

The range of expertise of the band’s members shines through, manifesting as a fusion of orchestral, funk, Americana, house, and rock, paired with the band’s established Celtic-influenced self-penned offerings.
Quote:
‘Majestic folk for our modern age… One of the most exciting new folk releases’
